description.text:
Boots, Canada Place, has now expanded, offering an increased range of Health & Beauty products, services and solutions, designed to help you "Look and Feel Good".

Our Beauty Hall has now been joined by Christian Dior, Yves Saint Laurent, Liz Earle, bareMinerals, Smashbox and the professional haircare ranges of Ojon and Bumble & Bumble. These now compliment the established expertise of No7, Clinique, Clarins, LancÃ�me, Chanel, EstÃ�e Lauder and Benefit.

Our expert Pharmacy Team offers a wide range of services above clinical advice and the fulfilling of prescriptions. These services include travel vaccinations, hair retention, flu vaccinations, erectile dysfunction service, stop smoking, emergency hormonal contraception, medicine check ups, new medicines service and repeat prescription provision.

Our larger store is also able to offer extended ranges for Healthcare and Toiletries products, Lunchtime food, Cosmetics and Fragrance.

We look forward to welcoming you into our store, where our simple aim is to help you "Look and Feel Good".

Location: Canada Place

Wherever you are in the shopping malls, there is always a Boots close by to accommodate your every need. Pick up your prescriptions, sandwiches, fragrances, cosmetics, and photographs.

At Jubilee Place you will also have access to our One Healthcare expert team, which includes Midnight Pharmacy, Healthcare and Boots Opticians. They offer a range of services including a Stop Smoking Service, Travel Clinic and Medicines Check-ups.

Boots Opticians offers Eye Checks and Contact Lens Checks, as well as Designer Brands, such as Prada, Ray Ban & Oakley, and our Contact Lens Reward Scheme. We also collect used glasses on behalf of Vision Aid Overseas.

Boots Jubilee Place also offers Premium Cosmetic Brands such as No. 7, Estee Lauder and Clinique and Benefit. Boots has everything you need to make you look and feel better.

Location: Jubilee Place
